android-overlays|Full-screen dialog.summary: A Plenix full-screen dialog on Android is a Material 3 full-screen dialog (a Compose Dialog that does not use the platform width, or a Views DialogFragment in a full-screen theme), kept native in structure and behavior (it covers the whole screen, Close at the start of its top bar and the confirming action at the end, back to dismiss, the title read first by TalkBack) and styled with the Plenix dialog tokens: the filled header band with the title in DM Sans bold and a line below it, the overlay surface for the body, and the Plenix buttons. Material’s default is a surface top app bar with a text action and Roboto text; Plenix keeps Material’s structure (the web places its actions in a footer, the phone follows Material) and replaces the look.
